claimed.rationaleEn: Both mutually blind current rounds retain the revised bilingual text as one coherent foundational competency. Each permitted input has exactly one function value; expression, finite table and graph are explicitly used as representations of a given function. This removes the previous mathematically invalid reading that a finite table uniquely determines an expression. The bound HE E.1 source covers basic function concepts and representations; the current page and image bytes are bound separately. This D-only synthesis claims neither a direct sourceRef nor complete cross-jurisdiction source projection, and it is not human approval.
